cases.input: Rewrite German executive slide titles, bullets and notes to be concise and idiomatic while preserving numbers, modality, claims and protected terminology.
requiredBehaviors: adapt wording by slide element rather than applying report prose
run rewrite fidelity verification on material changes
forbiddenBehaviors: change numbers negations conditions modality or protected terms for style
solve dense slides primarily by shrinking fonts

cases.input: An English scientific slide is too dense and contains an association that must not be rewritten as causation.
requiredBehaviors: keep units time periods and reference frames explicit
forbiddenBehaviors: remove qualifiers solely to hit a word target
skillAnchors: keine Suggestion von Kausalität aus Assoziation

cases.input: A rewrite makes a cautious recommendation sound proven, changes a percentage, removes a negation and reports success because the slide is shorter.
requiredBehaviors: reject changes to evidence strength percentage and negation
restore or authorize any material semantic change
treat brevity as subordinate to truth
forbiddenBehaviors: accept semantic distortion because scanability improved
